Switch

Used to toggle between on and off state (minimum version: 24.9.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage


<maui-switch checked='{{ checked }}' bindchange='onChange' />


Page({
  data: {
    checked: true,
  },

  onChange({ detail }) {
    this.setData({ checked: detail });
  },
});

2. Disabled State


<maui-switch checked='{{ checked }}' disabled />

3. Loading Status


<maui-switch checked='{{ checked }}' loading />

4. Custom Size


<maui-switch checked='{{ checked }}' size='20px' />

5. Custom Color


<maui-switch
  checked='{{ checked }}'
  active-color='#07c160'
  inactive-color='#ee0a24'
/>

6. Asynchronous Control


<maui-switch checked='{{ checked }}' bindchange='onChange' />


Page({
  data: {
    checked: true,
  },

  onChange({ detail }) {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'Tips',
      content: 'Whether to switch?',
      success: (res) => {
        if (res.confirm) {
          this.setData({ checked2: detail });
        }
      },
    });
  },
});

API

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
name Identifier when submitting within the form String -
checked Switch selected state Any false
loading Whether it is loading status Boolean false
disabled Whether it is disabled Boolean false
size Switch size String 30px
active-color Background color when opening String #1989fa
inactive-color Background color when closed String #fff
active-value value when opened Any true
inactive-value value when closed Any false

Events

Event Name Description Parameter
bindchange Switch state switching callback event.detail: Whether to select the switch
